description: How the TPS55289 regulator protects itself: overcurrent delay, hiccup restart, which faults pull the interrupt line and active discharge. Voltage, current limit and output are the Regulator block.

activation.text: Runs every pass while enabled: the settings are sent when one changes, a reading on every pass.

variants.description: Sets the protection of the regulator. The device keeps the values and writes them again each time it is enabled. Usually this is set once when the device is installed; use the block to change it while the program runs.

hints.text: Bit 0 overvoltage, bit 1 overcurrent, bit 2 short circuit: 7 masks all three

variants.description: Reads the protection settings of the regulator: overcurrent delay, hiccup mode, fault mask and active discharge.

activation.text: Reads on every pass while enabled; gate it with a periodic block to read less often.
